TCWHU Mobile App - Privacy & Community Rules

About TCWHU Mobile App

TCWHU Mobile App is a private, student-only, 1-on-1 messaging platform exclusively for verified TCU students. The app allows users to connect safely through private conversations based on year level, shared interests, and display names (nicknames).

Privacy Policy

1. Information We Collect
• Student Number: Used as the primary login credential and for verification.
• Photo Verification: A clear photo of a valid TCU ID and a selfie of the student holding the same ID.
• Profile Information: Display name or nickname (not real name), year level, and interests.
• Chat Data: Private 1-on-1 messages, including text, voice messages, images, and supported files.

2. How We Use Your Data
• To verify that users are legitimate TCU students.
• To prevent fake or duplicate accounts.
• To enable safe and private 1-on-1 messaging.
• To recommend connections based on year level and interests.
• To support reporting, moderation, and safety enforcement.

3. Data Privacy & Security
All personal data is stored securely and accessed only for verification and moderation purposes. TCWHU Mobile App complies with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (R.A. 10173). Personal information is never sold, shared, or disclosed to third parties.

Messaging, Voice & Media Sharing
• All chats are strictly 1-on-1 and private.
• Users may send text messages, voice messages, and photos.
• Supported file sharing includes documents such as PDF and DOC/DOCX files.
• Files and media may be downloaded only if they are in an allowed and supported file type.
• Voice messages are transmitted securely and are accessible only to the chat participants.
• Conversations are not publicly visible or searchable.

User Controls & Safety Features
• Report a user or specific chat messages.
• Block users to prevent further communication.
• Delete conversations at any time.
• Moderators may review reported content to enforce community rules.

Profile & App Features
• Users can view and manage their own profile information.
• Year level may only be changed once every year.
• Users can view school-related announcements and activities through the Events tab.

Community Guidelines

1. Keep It Safe
- Do not use your real name.
- Do not share personal information such as address, phone number, or social media accounts.
- Verification photos are private and used only for authentication.

2. Be Respectful
- No harassment, bullying, hate speech, or explicit content.
- Respect personal boundaries and privacy.

3. Violations & Enforcement
- First offense: Warning
- Repeated offense: Temporary suspension
- Severe or continued violation: Permanent account ban

Agreement & Compliance
By creating an account and using TCWHU Mobile App, you agree to comply with this Privacy Policy and Community Guidelines. Violations may result in account restriction or removal.

TCWHU Mobile App is committed to providing a secure, private, and respectful environment for verified TCU students.
